name: @cogito.ai/cc
description: Cogito CLI (`cc`) – game-dev scaffold + fixed pipeline for humans and AI agents (extracted from AgentDock)

scripts.build: pnpm run generate-registry && bun build bin/cc.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target node && cp src/registry.json dist/registry.json && rm -rf dist/templates && mkdir -p dist/templates && rsync -a --exclude='node_modules/' --exclude='.next/' --exclude='.turbo/' --exclude='dist-play/' --exclude='dist-learn/' --exclude='.selfcheck/' --exclude='.verify-result.json' --exclude='.playtest-screenshot.png' --exclude='.DS_Store' ../../templates/ dist/templates/ && find dist/templates -name '.gitignore' -exec sh -c 'mv "$1" "${1%/*}/_gitignore"' _ {} \; && find dist/templates -name '.npmrc' -exec sh -c 'mv "$1" "${1%/*}/_npmrc"' _ {} \;
